import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the Data sheet
df = pd.read_excel('/root/data.xlsx', sheet_name='Data', header=None)

# The headers are in row 7 (index 7)
# Column C (index 2) = Turn number
# Column D (index 3) = Game number
# Column E-J (index 4-9) = Roll 1-6
# The data starts at row 8 (index 8)

headers = df.iloc[7, 2:10].values  # Get headers from row 7, columns C-J
print("Headers from row 7:")
print(headers)

# Extract data starting from row 8
data_df = df.iloc[8:, 2:10].copy()
data_df.columns = headers
data_df = data_df.reset_index(drop=True)

# Convert to appropriate types
for col in ['Turn number', 'Game number']:
    data_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(data_df[col], errors='coerce')
    
for col in ['Roll 1', 'Roll 2', 'Roll 3', 'Roll 4', 'Roll 5', 'Roll 6']:
    data_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(data_df[col], errors='coerce')

# Remove rows with NaN values in key columns
data_df = data_df.dropna(subset=['Turn number', 'Game number'])

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("\nCleaned Data Structure:")
print(f"Number of rows: {len(data_df)}")
print(f"Number of columns: {len(data_df.columns)}")
print(f"\nColumn names: {list(data_df.columns)}")
print(f"\nData types:\n{data_df.dtypes}")

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("\nFirst 20 rows of data:")
print(data_df.head(20).to_string())

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("\nUnique Games Summary:")
unique_games = data_df['Game number'].unique()
print(f"Total unique games: {len(unique_games)}")
print(f"Game number range: {unique_games.min()} to {unique_games.max()}")
print(f"Total data rows: {len(data_df)}")

# Show which player plays which games
print("\n" + "="*80)
print("\nPlayer Assignment (based on odd/even game numbers):")
odd_games = [g for g in unique_games if g % 2 == 1]
even_games = [g for g in unique_games if g % 2 == 0]
print(f"Player 1 (odd-numbered games): {len(odd_games)} games (e.g., games {sorted(odd_games)[:5]}...)")
print(f"Player 2 (even-numbered games): {len(even_games)} games (e.g., games {sorted(even_games)[:5]}...)")

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("\nBasic statistics for rolls:")
print(data_df[['Roll 1', 'Roll 2', 'Roll 3', 'Roll 4', 'Roll 5', 'Roll 6']].describe())

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read without header
df = pd.read_excel('/root/data.xlsx', sheet_name='Data', header=None)

# Headers are in row 8 (index 8), columns C-J (indices 2-9)
headers = df.iloc[8, 2:10].values
print("Column Headers:")
print(headers)

# Data starts from row 9 (index 9)
data_df = df.iloc[9:, 2:10].copy()
data_df.columns = headers
data_df = data_df.reset_index(drop=True)

# Remove completely empty rows
data_df = data_df.dropna(how='all')

# Convert columns to numeric
for col in data_df.columns:
    data_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(data_df[col], errors='coerce')

# Remove rows where Turn number or Game number is NaN
data_df = data_df.dropna(subset=['Turn number', 'Game number'])

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("\nData Structure Summary:")
print(f"Total rows of game data: {len(data_df)}")
print(f"Total columns: {len(data_df.columns)}")
print(f"\nColumn names: {list(data_df.columns)}")
print(f"\nData types:")
for col in data_df.columns:
    print(f"  {col}: {data_df[col].dtype}")

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("\nFirst 20 rows of game data:")
print(data_df.head(20).to_string())

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("\nGame Summary:")
game_numbers = data_df['Game number'].unique()
game_numbers = game_numbers[~np.isnan(game_numbers)]
game_numbers_sorted = sorted(game_numbers)
print(f"Total unique games: {len(game_numbers_sorted)}")
print(f"Game number range: {int(game_numbers_sorted[0])} to {int(game_numbers_sorted[-1])}")
print(f"Total turns recorded: {len(data_df)}")

# Player assignment
odd_games = [int(g) for g in game_numbers_sorted if int(g) % 2 == 1]
even_games = [int(g) for g in game_numbers_sorted if int(g) % 2 == 0]
print(f"\nPlayer Assignment:")
print(f"  Player 1 (odd-numbered games): {len(odd_games)} games")
print(f"    Examples: {odd_games[:10]}")
print(f"  Player 2 (even-numbered games): {len(even_games)} games")
print(f"    Examples: {even_games[:10]}")

# Rolls statistics
print("\n" + "="*80)
print("\nRoll Statistics (all dice values across all turns):")
roll_cols = ['Roll 1', 'Roll 2', 'Roll 3', 'Roll 4', 'Roll 5', 'Roll 6']
print(data_df[roll_cols].describe())

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("\nTurns per Game:")
turns_per_game = data_df.groupby('Game number').size()
print(f"Average turns per game: {turns_per_game.mean():.2f}")
print(f"Min turns in a game: {turns_per_game.min()}")
print(f"Max turns in a game: {turns_per_game.max()}")
print(f"\nSample of turns per game:")
print(turns_per_game.head(20))
